g.text: Estimated global losses to fraud and hacking, $bn at 2025 prices
Columns: median estimates; whiskers: 80% credible intervals for the total, mostly uncertainty about the overall level (growth is
better determined). The 2026 column is a one-year projection from the 2022-25 trend, with wider bands. *Losses that would not
have happened without AI: the author's estimate, not a measurement; 2025 central estimate $5bn (2026 projection about $8bn),
Sources: FBI IC3; FTC; UK Finance; ACCC; Japan's National Police Agency; Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre; Singapore and Hong Kong
police; EBA; ECB; Chainalysis; FinCEN; ITRC; IBM; Sophos; ransomware.live; Verizon; Heiding et al.; national price indices; author's
Bayesian dynamic-factor model of 23 series and Monte Carlo estimate of AI's share
